sections.section_title: Using GPIO pins in VSW supply domain
sections.text_helper: Section 15.3.14 "Using GPIO pins in VSW supply domain" in chapter 15 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 791.
sections.section_content:
The functionality of PC13, PC14, PC15, and PQ7 GPIOs is lost when the core supply
domain is powered off (the device enters Standby mode). If their GPIO configuration is not
bypassed by the RTC/TAMP configuration or by the RCC (LSE), these pins are set in analog
input mode.
For details about I/O control by the RTC, refer to Section61.3: RTC functional description.
